_comment: The passive service catalog shared by the whole Nagios turn-key flow. add-nagios-bundle.ps1 turns each entry into a scheduler schedule (the entry name becomes the schedule name, which is the servicename NRDP submits), and setup-nagios-machine.ps1 bakes the same names into the Nagios VM as the service objects fleet-nagios-sync.sh renders per host. Only commands that exist on both Windows and Linux belong here.
